# SRT ↔ VTT converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/subtitle-converter/

Convert pasted SRT subtitles into WebVTT or convert WebVTT cues to SRT. Copy the timing and text or download a ready-to-use subtitle file.

## How to use it

1. Type or paste the text you want to work with.
2. Choose a conversion, clean-up or output option.
3. Copy the result or download it when an export is available.

## Example

Turn numbered SRT cues into a VTT file for an HTML video player.

## Limits and checks

The tool converts subtitle text, not speech. SRT output drops VTT positioning, style blocks and other format-specific presentation settings.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
